description: Player 1's deck for the combat spec. Three cards carry it: #11 Tempo Timmy (3/3, First Strike) is the attacker whose strike lands in §4.3 step 1, #20 Pointmaster (7/2, First Strike) is the attacker whose step-1 strike kills outright so the defender deals nothing back, and #8 Mr. Vanilla (3/3, no text) is the unit switched to Defense Position - vanilla on purpose, so the Taunt and the Armor 1 it gains can only have come from the position (§4.1). None of the three declares a play-time choice, so a combat assertion is never mixed up with a picker. The rest is choice-free filler; #1 Big D-fender is deliberately the only Armor aura in the deck and is never played, so the Armor in the pipeline arithmetic is exactly the Defense Position's +1. No card here carries a start-of-turn, end-of-turn or on-play hook that acts on the board (#58 Rush Token Farm and #64 Gifted Program were removed for exactly that): `triggerHoldersWithHook` in packages/engine/src/triggers.ts gathers those hooks from the HAND as well as the field, so a Rush Token Farm sitting in hand summons a unit every turn and a Gifted Program in hand makes a cheap play Radiant - which would move the board and the stats this spec asserts. Reported as an engine finding; the fixture does not rely on it either way.
